tempting_inference: Claim NHF's 2009 Chapter 11 means it liquidated immediately
observed_evidence: Court describes reorganization and later filings through FY2022
plausible_alternative: Chapter 11 reorganization does not establish liquidation; historical DAF sponsor later functioned in support role
justified_assessment: 2011–22 restructuring and wind-down not one closure event
discriminating_test: Inspect original bankruptcy completion and charter and final tax return

observed_evidence: IRS 2011 revocation plus June 2014 exemption-issued listing in IRS-derived ProPublica
plausible_alternative: Exemption or supporting org role may have changed/reissued, exact original determination unread
justified_assessment: 2011 revocation fact supported; later legal status requires per-date official registry
discriminating_test: Obtain official 2014 determination and FY2022 final confirmation
rule_for_final_report: Do not state continued revoked tax exemption

tempting_inference: 2022 zero assets means all individual DAF accounts were lost
observed_evidence: 2022 Form990 public extract shows $0 assets and $4.04m grant costs including $3.84m to UC
plausible_alternative: Grants may include transfer/charity benefit, donor accounts could have moved or terminated, no fund-level mapping
justified_assessment: Sponsor-account outcomes unknown; zero balance itself not loss
discriminating_test: Match schedule N grants, sponsor fund statements and successor EIN accounts
rule_for_final_report: No quantified beneficiary loss without account reconciliation

tempting_inference: The United Charitable $3.84m grant proves full DAF advisory rights moved
observed_evidence: 2022 extracted schedule grant payee and 2021 audited related-party relationship
plausible_alternative: Grant money is not proof fund-by-fund successor contract/rights, history, donor consent or ledger migration
justified_assessment: Recipient/payment identified in aggregate; actual DAF migration unverified
discriminating_test: Authorized donor account-to-account audit and transfer agreement
rule_for_final_report: No continuity pass on source grant alone

tempting_inference: Later IRS aggregator listing 2014 recognition proves current 2026 eligibility
observed_evidence: ProPublica shows 2014 recognized, not in most recent list; summary provider offers contradictory current labels
plausible_alternative: Determination may have changed again or nonprofit ceased by 2022
justified_assessment: Treat latest status unresolved; verify at date of contemplated gift
discriminating_test: Current IRS Pub78/BMF and determination letters plus legal dissolution search
rule_for_final_report: No financial donor recommendations based on stale aggregator

tempting_inference: Crown/Pinkaloo/Stellar acquisition proves Ren has a unified modern codebase
observed_evidence: Corporate announcements confirm transactions, platform names different
plausible_alternative: Multiple codebases, vendor-contracted services or phased migrations may coexist
justified_assessment: Corporate asset consolidation confirmed; software technical integration unverified
discriminating_test: Independent feature/custody ledger mapping and signed product architecture releases
rule_for_final_report: Do not count acquired software as new independent functioning stack

tempting_inference: Blackbaud exiting 2011 DAF software means no current Blackbaud DAF economic relationships
observed_evidence: 2011 sale of particular technology business, JustGiving current payment channel to Blackbaud Giving Fund
plausible_alternative: Adjacent sponsor payment entity differs from sold legacy admin software
justified_assessment: Historical divestiture does not imply Blackbaud ceased all DAF-related activity
discriminating_test: Entity/product-year graph, current Blackbaud Giving Fund and software contracts
rule_for_final_report: Keep product and sponsor legal distinctions

tempting_inference: Two vendor moves within 2024–26 prove the first vendor failed
observed_evidence: AEF notice documents Blackbaud→NPact and later move to Ren
plausible_alternative: Cost, service improvement, end-of-term or product strategy, not necessarily incidents
justified_assessment: Two platform supplier changes observed; no evidence either vendor insolvent
discriminating_test: Customer agreement change reasons and post-transition continuity testing
rule_for_final_report: Do not assign bad engineering to any vendor

tempting_inference: New portal only displaying 2 years means older donor/account records were deleted
observed_evidence: AEF explicitly directs users to staff for older grant/gift history
plausible_alternative: Archived records may exist but not available directly in donor UI
justified_assessment: Restricted self-service history observed; actual legal record retention unknown
discriminating_test: Independently request 5–10 year transaction/receipt history and reconcile
rule_for_final_report: Differentiate UI access vs permanent deletion

tempting_inference: 2024 provider change removing old unsubmitted grant drafts means approved grants were lost
observed_evidence: AEF specified shopping-cart drafts older than 90 days removed and recurring grants continued
plausible_alternative: Unsubmitted grant drafts not same as approved/disbursed grant ledger
justified_assessment: Known minor draft deletion, no proven approved grant loss
discriminating_test: Reconcile approved grants and cash posting across cutoff, export unsubmitted drafts where justified
rule_for_final_report: No claim of missing cash without bank proof

tempting_inference: Classy or DAFgiving360 name change is a defunct platform
observed_evidence: Official notices say products and sponsoring charities continue
plausible_alternative: Legal entity renamed vs service terminated differ
justified_assessment: Zero verified firm failure from these rebrands
discriminating_test: Check continuing EIN, signed contracts and grant activity
rule_for_final_report: Keep status as rebrand, not mortality

tempting_inference: Blackbaud→Ren or TIFIN→FS acquisition implies charity money was part of software asset sale
observed_evidence: Announcements cover vendor DAF-related technology or independent giving product
plausible_alternative: DAF legal sponsor owns fund contributions, vendor stock deal does not itself sell DAF assets
justified_assessment: Product vendor ownership change not proof of changes to charity money
discriminating_test: Match sponsor charter/custodial contract and actual asset movement when claimed

tempting_inference: TakeCharge/Everfund/Kambeo/Flipcause failures measure DAF platform mortality rate
observed_evidence: These businesses were adjacent fundraising/intermediary offerings, not verified core admin systems
plausible_alternative: Different business units and sponsor legal operations; discovered samples not systematic
justified_assessment: Useful failure-mode case studies, no valid rate numerator or denominator
discriminating_test: Population frame of DAF technology vendors plus legally defined and confirmed exits

tempting_inference: No many confirmed core DAF closures means technology market is more stable
observed_evidence: A handful of public acquisitions and transitions were easily searchable
plausible_alternative: Private company delistings, client migrations, EIN changes and dormant products may be invisible
justified_assessment: Rate unknown; observed sample biased toward newsworthy firms and maintained sponsor pages
discriminating_test: Build complete sponsor EIN-year and vendor SKU-year panels with evidence tiers

tempting_inference: NHF DAF sponsor history plus AEF migration show one general 'platform risk'
observed_evidence: NHF legal regulator and asset trajectory; AEF vendor UI and data continuity
plausible_alternative: Legal charity vs technology service failures impose different rights and controls
justified_assessment: Audit separately legal status, fund custody, portal access, record archives and grants
discriminating_test: Sponsor insolvency drill and independent data migration tests

tempting_inference: Benevity Alaya announced 2026-12-15 sunset means service already closed on 2026-11-11
justified_assessment: Scheduled as-of cutoff, do not count among occurred exits
discriminating_test: Check dated post-December completion and actual migration
rule_for_final_report: Exclude scheduled from historical failure count

tempting_inference: Pinkaloo founder acquisition announcement implies poor standalone economics
observed_evidence: Founder describes acceleration and company acquisition
plausible_alternative: Strategic exit vs lack of cash flow vs customer needs unknown
justified_assessment: Acquisition fact, financial failure hypothesis unproven
discriminating_test: Historical income and acquisition terms; case studies from independent sources
rule_for_final_report: Do not label acquired vendor insolvent

tempting_inference: Source databases disagreeing on NHF zero vs absent assets prove a database error in IRS originals
observed_evidence: IRS-based public aggregators vary in labeling missing assets and final status
plausible_alternative: Rendering conventions and available schedules may differ, original FY2022 PDF not retrievable
justified_assessment: Keep exact source and observed 990 totals; flag missing original return image
discriminating_test: Compare IRS FY2022 XML and original complete 990/Sch N with public extracts
rule_for_final_report: No fabricated definitive balance continuity conclusion
